# Bank Statement Spending Analysis Report

**Accounts Analyzed:** ICICI Bank Checking ...2023

### 1. Executive Summary
- **Statement Period:** 2023-01-01 – 2023-12-26
- **Total Inflow (Income/Deposits):** ₹2,625,200.00
- **Total Outflow (Actual Spending):** ₹1,865,776.00
- **Net Cash Flow (Surplus):** +₹759,424.00
- **Savings / Retention Rate:** 28.9%

### 2. Category Breakdown Table
| Category | Total Spent | % of Total Spend | Top 3 Merchants / Drivers |

| Shopping & Discretionary | ₹325,200.00 | 17.4% | AMAZON.IN ONLINE SHOPPING ELECTRONICS & HOME (₹100,800.00), TANISHQ JEWELLERS FESTIVE DIWALI GOLD PURCHASE (₹84,000.00), MYNTRA FASHION APPAREL SHOPPING (₹81,600.00) |
| Dining Out & Food Delivery | ₹92,400.00 | 5.0% | SWIGGY FOOD DELIVERY & DINEIN (₹45,600.00), ZOMATO ONLINE RESTAURANT ORDER (₹29,400.00), STARBUCKS COFFEE INDIRANAGAR (₹17,400.00) |

| Transportation | ₹55,200.00 | 3.0% | UBER INDIA COMMUTE RIDES (₹55,200.00) |

- **Total Monthly Recurring Commitments:** **₹110,948.00/month**

### 4. Key Observations & Actionable Insights
#### Top Outflow Drivers
- #1 Uncategorized / Needs Review: ₹1,125,400.00 (60.2% of total spend) — Primary drivers: ACH DEBIT ZERODHA BROKING MUTUAL FUND SIP (₹540,000.00), MYGATE APARTMENT GATED COMMUNITY MAINTENANCE (₹222,000.00)
- #2 Shopping & Discretionary: ₹325,200.00 (17.4% of total spend) — Primary drivers: AMAZON.IN ONLINE SHOPPING ELECTRONICS & HOME (₹100,800.00), TANISHQ JEWELLERS FESTIVE DIWALI GOLD PURCHASE (₹84,000.00)
- #3 Dining Out & Food Delivery: ₹92,400.00 (5.0% of total spend) — Primary drivers: SWIGGY FOOD DELIVERY & DINEIN (₹45,600.00), ZOMATO ONLINE RESTAURANT ORDER (₹29,400.00)

#### Anomalies / Spikes
- ₹180,000.00 • URBAN LADDER & WOODENSTREET INTERIOR FURNISHING on 2023-03-15 (Uncategorized / Needs Review) [Possible Internal Transfer] — Triggered Rule: Amount is 18.0× average transaction size (₹9,977.41).
- ₹85,000.00 • UPI/ANANYA SHARMA/MODULAR KITCHEN WOODWORK CONTRACTOR on 2023-06-22 (Uncategorized / Needs Review) [Possible Internal Transfer] — Triggered Rule: Amount is 8.5× average transaction size (₹9,977.41).
- ₹84,000.00 • TANISHQ JEWELLERS FESTIVE DIWALI GOLD PURCHASE on 2023-10-24 (Shopping & Discretionary) [Major Outflow Spike] — Triggered Rule: Amount is 8.4× average transaction size (₹9,977.41).
- ₹62,000.00 • CHQ 301920 CLEARING TO HOME APPLIANCES LG REFRIGERATOR on 2023-08-04 (Miscellaneous / Other) [Possible Internal Transfer] — Triggered Rule: Amount is 6.2× average transaction size (₹9,977.41).
- ₹58,400.00 • MAKEMYTRIP HOLIDAY FLIGHTS & RESORT BOOKING GOA on 2023-09-12 (Uncategorized / Needs Review) [Possible Internal Transfer] — Triggered Rule: Amount is 5.9× average transaction size (₹9,977.41).

#### Optimization Opportunities
- **Audit Recurring Subscriptions (15 detected)**: You are committing **₹110,948.00/mo** (₹1,331,376.00/year) on services like ACH DEBIT ZERODHA BROKING MUTUAL FUND SIP, MYGATE APARTMENT GATED COMMUNITY MAINTENANCE, AMAZON.IN ONLINE SHOPPING ELECTRONICS & HOME, MYNTRA FASHION APPAREL SHOPPING. Canceling or pausing 2 unused subscriptions could trim recurring leaks.
- **Trim Dining & Delivery Leaks**: Dining out consumed **₹92,400.00** (5.0% of total spend). Shifting 2 restaurant orders or delivery meals per week toward groceries would save an estimated **₹23,100.00 monthly**.
- **Discretionary Shopping Guardrail**: Shopping accounted for **₹325,200.00** (17.4% of budget). Implementing a cooling-off rule for non-essential purchases can curb impulsive checkouts.

### 5. Security & Privacy Guardrails
- **Redaction Verification:** All bank account numbers have been masked to last 4 digits only (e.g., `Savings ...1234`). Full SSNs, PAN, Aadhaar, routing/IFSC numbers, and residential street addresses have been scrubbed.
- **Data Integrity Verified:** All category totals sum to exactly ₹1,865,776.00 (100% of total outflow). Internal transfers (12 transactions) and double-counted credit card payoffs have been excluded.
